# Arduino_dsPIC33CK Platform Configuration
# Integrates Microchip XC-DSC into Arduino IDE
#
# C++ SUPPORT: XC-DSC v4.00+ includes native C++ support (xc-dsc-g++.exe).
# .cpp and .ino files compile as real C++ with classes, templates, and
# function overloading. For older XC-DSC (v3.x), falls back to C mode.
#
# DFP COMPATIBILITY: Older DFP headers use __prog__ qualifier which is
# C-only. The -D__prog__="" flag in cpp.flags makes them C++ compatible.
#
# PORTABILITY: All machine-specific paths are in platform.local.txt
# (generated by install_arduino_ide.bat). This file uses only variables.

name=Arduino_dsPIC33CK
version=1.0.0

# ============================================================
# Compiler Configuration
# ============================================================

# Path comes from platform.local.txt (set by installer)
compiler.path={build.compiler.path}
compiler.c.cmd=xc-dsc-g++
compiler.cpp.cmd=xc-dsc-g++
compiler.asm.cmd=xc-dsc-as
compiler.ar.cmd=xc-dsc-ar
compiler.ld.cmd=xc-dsc-gcc
compiler.objcopy.cmd=xc-dsc-objcopy
compiler.size.cmd=xc-dsc-size
compiler.bin2hex.cmd=xc-dsc-bin2hex

# Default compiler path (OVERRIDE in platform.local.txt for your machine)
build.compiler.path=C:/Program Files/Microchip/xc-dsc/v4.00/bin/

# Default DFP path (OVERRIDE in platform.local.txt for your machine)
build.dfp.path=

# ============================================================
# Compiler Flags
# ============================================================

compiler.warning_flags=-Wall
compiler.warning_flags.none=-w
compiler.warning_flags.default=-Wall
compiler.warning_flags.more=-Wall -Wextra
compiler.warning_flags.all=-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic

# C compilation flags
# NOTE: .c files are compiled as C++ (-x c++) via extra_flags to ensure
# ABI-compatible object signatures when linking with .cpp objects.
# For XC-DSC v3.x (no C++ support), override c.extra_flags="" in platform.local.txt.
compiler.c.flags=-mcpu={build.mcu} -mdfp={build.dfp.path} -c -g -O1 -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -mno-eds-warn -D__prog__="" -DARDUINO={runtime.ide.version} -DARDUINO_{build.board} -DARDUINO_ARCH_DSPIC33 -DF_CPU={build.f_cpu} -DFCY={build.fcy}
compiler.c.extra_flags=-x c++ -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti -fno-threadsafe-statics -fno-use-cxa-atexit

# C++ flags (XC-DSC v4.00+ has native C++ support)
compiler.cpp.flags=-mcpu={build.mcu} -mdfp={build.dfp.path} -c -g -O1 -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -mno-eds-warn -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti -fno-threadsafe-statics -fno-use-cxa-atexit -D__prog__="" -DARDUINO={runtime.ide.version} -DARDUINO_{build.board} -DARDUINO_ARCH_DSPIC33 -DF_CPU={build.f_cpu} -DFCY={build.fcy}
compiler.cpp.extra_flags=

# Assembly flags
compiler.asm.flags=-mcpu={build.mcu} -mdfp={build.dfp.path} -c -g
compiler.asm.extra_flags=

# Archive flags
compiler.ar.flags=rcs
compiler.ar.extra_flags=

# Linker flags
compiler.ld.flags=-mcpu={build.mcu} -mdfp={build.dfp.path} -T {build.dfp.path}/support/dsPIC33C/gld/p{build.mcu}.gld
compiler.ld.extra_flags=

# ============================================================
# Compile Patterns
# ============================================================

# C source files (.c)
recipe.c.o.pattern="{compiler.path}{compiler.c.cmd}" {compiler.c.flags} {compiler.c.extra_flags} {compiler.warning_flags} {includes} "{source_file}" -o "{object_file}"

# C++ / .ino files
# If xc-dsc-g++.exe exists: compiles as real C++ (classes, templates, overloading)
# If xc-dsc-g++.exe missing: override compiler.cpp.cmd back to xc-dsc-gcc in
#   platform.local.txt and add -x c to compiler.cpp.extra_flags
recipe.cpp.o.pattern="{compiler.path}{compiler.cpp.cmd}" {compiler.cpp.flags} {compiler.cpp.extra_flags} {compiler.warning_flags} {includes} "{source_file}" -o "{object_file}"

# Assembly files (.s, .S)
recipe.S.o.pattern="{compiler.path}{compiler.asm.cmd}" {compiler.asm.flags} {compiler.asm.extra_flags} {includes} "{source_file}" -o "{object_file}"

# ============================================================
# Archive (library) Pattern
# ============================================================

recipe.ar.pattern="{runtime.platform.path}/tools/suppress-stderr.bat" "{compiler.path}xc-dsc-ar.exe" {compiler.ar.flags} {compiler.ar.extra_flags} "{archive_file_path}" "{object_file}"

# ============================================================
# Link Pattern
# ============================================================

recipe.c.combine.pattern="{runtime.platform.path}/tools/xc-dsc-link.bat" "{compiler.path}xc-dsc-gcc.exe" {compiler.ld.flags} {compiler.ld.extra_flags} -o "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.elf" {object_files} -Wl,--whole-archive "{build.path}/{archive_file}" -Wl,--no-whole-archive -lm

# ============================================================
# Post-build: Create HEX file
# ============================================================

recipe.objcopy.hex.pattern="{runtime.platform.path}/tools/suppress-stderr.bat" "{compiler.path}xc-dsc-bin2hex.exe" -mdfp={build.dfp.path} "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.elf"

# ============================================================
# Size computation
# ============================================================

recipe.size.pattern="{runtime.platform.path}/tools/xc-dsc-size-wrapper.bat" "{compiler.path}" "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.elf"
recipe.size.regex=^(?:\.text|\.data|\.rodata)\s+([0-9]+).*
recipe.size.regex.data=^(?:\.data|\.bss|\.noinit)\s+([0-9]+).*

# ============================================================
# Pre-processing (for Arduino IDE .ino handling)
# ============================================================

# Arduino IDE needs these for .ino preprocessing (dependency scan only, no ABI concern)
preproc.includes.flags=-mcpu={build.mcu} -mdfp={build.dfp.path} -D__prog__="" -DF_CPU={build.f_cpu} -DFCY={build.fcy} -DARDUINO={runtime.ide.version} -DARDUINO_{build.board} -DARDUINO_ARCH_DSPIC33
recipe.preproc.includes="{compiler.path}xc-dsc-gcc" -M -MG {preproc.includes.flags} {includes} -x c "{source_file}"
recipe.preproc.macros="{compiler.path}xc-dsc-gcc" -E -dM {preproc.includes.flags} {includes} -x c "{source_file}" -o "{preprocessed_file_path}"

# ============================================================
# Upload Tools
# ============================================================

# Tool: UART Bootloader (Python script)
tools.dspic33ck_upload.cmd=python3
tools.dspic33ck_upload.cmd.windows=python.exe
tools.dspic33ck_upload.path={runtime.platform.path}/tools
tools.dspic33ck_upload.upload.params.verbose=-v
tools.dspic33ck_upload.upload.params.quiet=
tools.dspic33ck_upload.upload.pattern="{cmd}" "{path}/upload_uart.py" --port "{serial.port}" --baud {upload.speed} --hex "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.hex"

# Tool: PICkit 4 via MPLAB IPE command line
tools.pickit4.cmd=ipecmd
tools.pickit4.cmd.windows=ipecmd.exe
tools.pickit4.path={build.tools.mplab.path}
tools.pickit4.upload.params.verbose=
tools.pickit4.upload.params.quiet=
tools.pickit4.upload.pattern="{path}/{cmd}" -TPPK4 -P{build.mcu} -M -OL -F"{build.path}/{build.project_name}.hex"

# Tool: MPLAB SNAP
tools.snap.cmd=ipecmd
tools.snap.cmd.windows=ipecmd.exe
tools.snap.path={build.tools.mplab.path}
tools.snap.upload.params.verbose=
tools.snap.upload.params.quiet=
tools.snap.upload.pattern="{path}/{cmd}" -TPSNAP -P{build.mcu} -M -OL -F"{build.path}/{build.project_name}.hex"

# Tool: PICkit 5 via MPLAB IPE command line
tools.pickit5.cmd=ipecmd
tools.pickit5.cmd.windows=ipecmd.exe
tools.pickit5.path={build.tools.mplab.path}
tools.pickit5.upload.params.verbose=
tools.pickit5.upload.params.quiet=
tools.pickit5.upload.pattern="{path}/{cmd}" -TPPK5 -P{build.mcu} -M -OL -F"{build.path}/{build.project_name}.hex"

# Tool: PKOB4 (PICkit On Board 4 - built into Curiosity boards)
tools.pkob4.cmd=ipecmd
tools.pkob4.cmd.windows=ipecmd.exe
tools.pkob4.path={build.tools.mplab.path}
tools.pkob4.upload.params.verbose=
tools.pkob4.upload.params.quiet=
tools.pkob4.upload.pattern="{path}/{cmd}" -TPPKOB4 -P{build.mcu} -M -OL -F"{build.path}/{build.project_name}.hex"
